correctness.rationale: The Kleinschmidt smooth four/five-facet classification reduces the full three-dimensional claim to a dilated unimodular tetrahedron aΔ3 (a≥1) and two lattice-simplex bundles with p+q=3, a,b≥1, nonnegative integral twists. Reconstructed exact lattice-slice sums L12=(bk+1)(bk+2)[1+k(a+bC/3)]/2 and L21=(bk+1)[(ak+1)(ak+2)+Cbk(2ak+3)/2+C²bk(2bk+1)/6]/2. Independently built degree-three h* by fourth finite differences and computed its cubic discriminant in SymPy: precisely 139 and 338 nonzero positive rational monomials after A=a−1,B=b−1,C≥0. Verified strict boundary factorizations, degree-drop linear cases, and simplex discriminant; Stanley h*-nonnegativity makes all simple real roots strictly negative. The symbolic identity checks cover infinite parameter ranges, not just numerical enumeration; the classification and nonnegativity are imported theorems.
